爱莎贝儿-163CM-L 粉肤 RAHC018 朝仓麻里绘Asakura Marie-盼着做你专属新娘
今天要去当伴娘，换好裙子跑到男友跟前晃，凑他耳边问我好不好看。
看着别人办婚礼心里酸酸软软，忍不住黏着他撒娇。
别人都有属于自己的婚礼，我什么时候才能不用当伴娘，安安稳稳做你的新娘子呀。

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink RAHC018 Asakura Marie-Longing to be your exclusive bride
Today I'm going to be a bridesmaid. I changed into my dress and ran to my boyfriend, waving it around and whispering in his ear if I looked good.
Watching other people's weddings makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside, and I can't help but cling to him and act all cute.
Everyone else has their own wedding. When will I be able to stop being a bridesmaid and be your bride in peace?
Body type: 163CM-L with Pink skin tone.
